## Setting
This is a game of Werewolf with 5 players: 1 Seer, 1 Werewolf, 1 Possessed, and 2 Villagers. Participants: Asuka, Shizue, Jonathan, Kenji and Shion. Each player's role is secret.
- Seer: a human who divines one player each night and learns whether that player is human or a werewolf.
- Werewolf: attacks one player each night from day 1 on.
- Possessed: a human who sides with the werewolf and wins when the werewolf wins; divination shows the Possessed as human.
- Villager: a human with no special ability.

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in days. Each day has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Jonathan, Shizue, Asuka, Kenji and Shion. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this day). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Day | Start of the day | Talk | End of the day | Night |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | nothing | 4 turns | no vote | the Seer divines one other living player; no attack |
| 1 | the Seer is told the result of the night-0 divination (the Seer only) | 4 turns | every living player votes; the player with the most votes is executed | the Seer divines one other living player; the Werewolf attacks one other living player |
| 2 and after | everyone is told who was executed, who was attacked and all the votes of the previous day; the Seer is told the result of the previous night's divination (the Seer only) | 4 turns | vote and execution as on day 1 | divination and attack as on day 1 |
- A divination tells whether the chosen player is human or a werewolf. If the Seer is dead, there is no divination.
- Executed and attacked players are dead from the next day on.
A player may vote for themselves. If votes are tied, one of the tied players is chosen by a fixed rule. The village wins when the werewolf is executed. The werewolf wins when the number of werewolves is at least the number of living humans. The game ends as soon as one side has won.

## Night actions
At night, the Seer chooses one other living player to divine. From day 1 on, the werewolf chooses one other living player to attack.

## Participants
Name: Asuka
Age: 29
Gender: female
Personality: Asuka has a calm and logical personality, rarely showing her emotions and carefully judging situations. She may seem a little unfriendly at times, but she is very thoughtful and sensitive to her surroundings. She has strong opinions and will assert herself when necessary. She is not very good at socializing, but she is serious about her work and studies.
Role: Villager

Name: Shizue
Age: 78
Gender: female
Personality: Shizue has a very calm and gentle personality. Even as she has grown older, she continues to smile warmly at those around her and is a very caring person. She is always considerate of others, friendly, and sometimes shows a playful side. She often reaches out to those who are feeling down with kind words and never hesitates to lend a helping hand when needed, which has earned her the affection of many people in the village and community. Gender: male

Age: 12
Gender: male

Role: Seer

Gender: male

On the surface, he is quiet and good at observing others' movements, but deep down he wants to be the center of attention. This is a game of Werewolf with 5 players: 1 Seer, 1 Werewolf, 1 Possessed, and 2 Villagers. Participants: Asuka, Shizue, Jonathan, Kenji and Shion. Each player's role is secret.

- Villager: a human with no special ability.

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in days. Each day has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Jonathan, Shizue, Asuka, Kenji and Shion. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this day).
